summary: This clinical trial compares two different drugs, Enavogliflozin and Pioglitazone, in adults with type 2 diabetes. The study looks at how well each drug helps lower blood sugar when added to current treatments like Metformin. Researchers plan to enroll 120 participants for this Phase 4 study. Seoul National University Bundang Hospital is sponsoring the research, and the status is currently Recruiting.
